subject: non-interactive install of example-models package in rstan?

messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: non-interactive install of example-models package in rstan?
parts:
Hi!

How can I install non-interactively the example-models in rstan?

I would like to install rstan via scripts into our cluster and include the example-models with it, but it must be done non-interactively.

Thanks!

Best,
Sebastian

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: non-interactive install of example-models package in rstan?
parts:
On Tuesday, July 21, 2015 at 12:25:58 PM UTC-4, Sebastian Weber wrote:
How can I install non-interactively the example-models in rstan?

I would like to install rstan via scripts into our cluster and include the example-models with it, but it must be done non-interactively.

#!/bin/bash -e

MODELS_HOME=`Rscript -e 'cat(system.file("include", package = "rstan"))'`
cd "${MODELS_HOME}"
wget https://github.com/stan-dev/example-models/archive/master.zip
unzip master.zip
rm master.zip
exit 0

Ben
